armies_of_renown.name: Da King's Gitz
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Gloomspite Gitz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Da King’s Gitz Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Gloomspite Gitz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the KING’S GITZ keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Skragrott, the Loonking (must be included and must be your general)
Any MOONCLAN units
0-1 Bad Moon Loonshrine
0-2 non-HERO TROGGOTH units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: The Moon and the Loon
battle_traits.effect:
While a friendly unit is wholly within 9" of a friendly Skragrott, a friendly Malevolent Moon or a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine:
• Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN units.
• Instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly SQUIG unit, you can use a value of 4.

battle_traits.name: Da King's Guards
battle_traits.effect:
While a friendly TROGGOTH unit is within the combat range of a friendly HERO:
• That friendly HERO has WARD (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that HERO, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly TROGGOTH unit within that HERO's combat range after the damage sequence for that HERO has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battle_traits.name: Da Loonking's Court
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE KING'S GITZ HEROES that do not have an enhancement.
battle_traits.effect: Give each HERO 1 enhancement from the 'Da King's Gitz' Army of Renown rules.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: These enhancements are given to the HEROES during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

entries.name: Da King's Adjutant
entries.declare: You cannot use this ability and the Bad Moon Loonshrine's 'Moonclan Lairs' ability in the same turn. While this unit is within 12" of a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine, pick a friendly non-reinforced, non-HERO, non-MONSTER KING'S GITZ unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine and more than 3" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Glarejester
entries.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit within 3" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a D3. Add the roll to the distance the target can move when using MOVE abilities this phase. If the target ends a move in this phase within 3" of this HERO, inflict an amount of mortal damage on this HERO equal to the roll.

enhancement_tables.name: Artefacts of Power
enhancement_tables.group: Artefacts of Power: The King's Gitz

entries.name: Moonhoned Shiv
entries.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. In addition, each time this unit uses a RETREAT ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

entries.name: Loonstone Medallion
entries.effect: This unit has WARD (6+). While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, it has WARD (5+).

entries.name: Wotnot of Prestige
entries.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
entries.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Da Loonking's Command
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KING'S GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by champions in the target unit.
• If the target uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6.
• Add 1 to the target's control score.

entries.name: Right Gitz in da Right Place
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KING'S GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target's weapons have Anti-HERO (+1 Rend) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Moon on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Malevolent Moon wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

armies_of_renown.name: Droggz's Gitmob
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Gloomspite Gitz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Droggz’s Gitmob Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules below instead of the Gloomspite Gitz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box opposite. All units in your army gain the DROGGZ’S GITMOB keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Droggz da Sunchompa (must be included and must be your general)
Any GITMOB units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Get Around 'Em
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB unit that has not been deployed.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve outflanking the enemy. It has now been deployed.

battle_traits.name: Glowering Light
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB unit that has charged this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot make a pile-in move when it is picked to use a FIGHT ability.

battle_traits.name: Surprise, Ya Gitz!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB unit that is outflanking the enemy.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Dis Fight's Not Fer Me
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB unit that is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn and is not in combat with any enemy units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: Stick 'Em and Run
entries.effect: Each time this unit uses a RETREAT ability or the 'Frazzlegit's Flame Stream' ability, before moving this unit, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Plucky Git
entries.effect: While this unit has no damage points, friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.

entries.name: Glareface's Grin
entries.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
entries.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Frazzleblast
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly DROGGZ'S GITMOB unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Mork's Mighty Mushroom on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Mork's Mighty Mushroom wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

armies_of_renown.name: Trugg's Troggherd
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Gloomspite Gitz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Trugg’s Troggherd Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules below instead of the Gloomspite Gitz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the TRUGG’S TROGGHERD keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Trugg the Troggoth King (must be included and must be your general)
Dankhold Troggboss
Dankhold Troggoth
Fellwater Troggoths
Rockgut Troggoths
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Herd Healing
battle_traits.effect: Each time a friendly TROGGOTH unit uses a FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved, Heal (D3) that unit.

battle_traits.name: Aura of Haywire Magic
battle_traits.effect: The effects of a friendly Trugg's 'Malfunctioning Leystone' ability affect friendly TRUGG'S TROGGHERD units anywhere on the battlefield instead of only those wholly within 12" of that friendly Trugg.

battle_traits.name: Moon-toughened Hide
battle_traits.effect: In battle rounds 2 and 3, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target friendly TRUGG'S TROGGHERD units.

battle_traits.name: Living Landmark
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly TRUGG'S TROGGHERD unit that has not been deployed.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a living landmark. It has now been deployed.

battle_traits.name: Broken Slumber
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly TRUGG'S TROGGHERD unit that is a living landmark.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Loonstone Teef
entries.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Crunchy Shinies
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
